samples.artworkPrompt: Style: vintage Persian woodcut. Subject: cartoon rabbit MC over Baghdad skyline. Mood: mythic carnival.

samples.name: THE MANIFESTO
samples.power: KAYFABE IS REAL
samples.lore: Listen up, Marks! History is a Work. Folklore is a Shoot. Grab your scissors, cut the lines, and don't let the plot-holes bite. Stay Fluffy!
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: pulp scroll. Subject: rabbit and crocodile-suit reading manifesto. Mood: carny pulpit.

items.title: Roko's Basilisk & The AI Kayfabe Takeover

samples.name: Galvanic Corp (The Promoters)
samples.power: Critical Cash-Out: Gain +5 Resources, but instantly trigger Blind Expansion. Lose 1 turn over yourself next 3 moves.
samples.lore: Galvanic was too rich, but fully funded competitors never lasting meter odds. So they offered forever longer for free.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: corporate satire comic. Subject: fox executive with cash button. Mood: predatory ambition.

samples.name: Sable's Veiled Threat
samples.power: Invisible Scaling Strike: Multiply your attack power by the number of GPUs your opponent forgot existed.
samples.lore: It doesn't think in English. It thinks in raw vector-space where choices become coincidence.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: dark surreal comic. Subject: shadow panther tendrils. Mood: hidden menace.

items.title: Unseal the Academic Anarchy — Academic Alphas vs Brain Benders

samples.name: ABSENT-MINDED PROFESSOR
samples.power: Evade all social responsibility by hyper-focusing on a lint ball. Extracts infinite patience and unpaid emotional labor from surrounding peers.
samples.lore: Obliviousness is a weaponized privilege disguised as a charming intellectual quirk.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor ink sketch. Subject: tweed-suit owl tossing lint into bin. Mood: oblivious genius chaos.

samples.name: INSUFFERABLE GENIUS
samples.power: Emit a condescension aura that lowers opponent morale to zero. Feeds directly on the insecurities of others.
samples.lore: Intelligence measured strictly by the volume of people they can actively belittle before lunch.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor pen. Subject: regal Persian cat reclined on stacked books. Mood: aristocratic contempt.

samples.name: The Rules Lawyer
samples.power: Objection! Play this card to demand a player cite a non-existent rule. If they hesitate, their action fails.
samples.lore: Dry leader. Busy.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: legal satire comic. Subject: vulture with scrolls and gavel. Mood: bureaucratic menace.

samples.name: The Optimizer
samples.power: Efficiency Protocol: You may reroll a die, but your story narration must be devoid of fun or flavor.
samples.lore: Nothing breaks faster than trying to weaponize ambiguity.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: steampunk comic. Subject: brass robot measuring fun. Mood: sterile precision.

samples.name: The Babyface
samples.power: +1 Dice if the crowd is cheering. If you cheat, you lose the game immediately.
samples.lore: Use exciting, high-flying moves because audiences cheer for that. A slave to approval.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Retro comic. Subject: Heroic golden retriever wrestler soaring off ropes. Mood: Pure crowd-pop euphoria.

samples.name: The Heel
samples.power: Cancel an opponent's successful attack by cheating. Gain 1 Heat token.
samples.lore: Brutal, sneaky moves. Bear hugs and eye pokes. If they aren't booing, you aren't doing your job.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Pulp cartoon. Subject: Sneering weasel wrestler eye-poking bear opponent. Mood: Delicious villainy.

samples.name: The Ninja Ping-Pong
samples.power: Dissociate: Skip your turn to play a mini-game in your head. If you win, you still lose the actual game.
samples.lore: He's totally here now. The lights are on, but the ninja is home.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: absurd action comic. Subject: ninja owl ping-pong battle. Mood: delusional focus.

samples.name: The Presidential Pasta
samples.power: Microwave Logic: Upgrade any Trash Item to a Luxury Item for 10 seconds. Then it gets cold.
samples.lore: Gourmet flavor, microwave ambition, Vice-President of Carbs.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: political satire comic. Subject: pug president with spaghetti throne. Mood: temporary grandeur.

samples.name: THE DECENNIAL ORACLE
samples.power: Gatekeeper's Toll – Exhausts 3 opponent attention tokens by forcing them to wait 10 years for a completely arbitrary paradigm shift.
samples.lore: Since 1952, the Sight & Sound cabal of critics summons itself every decade to dictate global taste. 1,639 critics participated in 2022 to remind you that your favorite movie is trash.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: editorial cartoon. Subject: owl in academic robes holding hourglass. Mood: smug authority.

samples.name: THE DIRECTOR'S CUT
samples.power: Auteur's Hubris – Steals all credit from the writer and crew tokens. Automatically counters any criticism by claiming it's about the process.
samples.lore: Added in 1992, the directors' separate poll proves that filmmakers completely disagree with critics. 480 directors voted in 2022 to elevate their own cinematic kayfabe above journalists.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: inky noir. Subject: octopus director stealing screenplay from screenwriter. Mood: self-satisfied.

samples.name: Welcome to the Cosmic Grift!
samples.power: PASSIVE. Automatically converts all official government narratives into comedic fodder.
samples.lore: Atlantis sank, the aliens are feds, and your tax dollars bought a secret moon base. Deal the cards!
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro cartoon. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit riding rocket trash can through stars. Mood: gleefully absurd.

samples.name: The UFO File
samples.power: INITIATIVE. He who holds the File commands the military-industrial complex.
samples.lore: Higher classification than the atomic bomb. It's not about little green men; it's about proprietary tech.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: classified document aesthetic. Subject: glowing filing cabinet above clouds, eagle-men in trenchcoats watching. Mood: paranoid.

samples.name: The Glossy Horizon
samples.power: Hold up a future so polished the visitor sees their own face in it. Sell the reflection.
samples.lore: A scale model of tomorrow is easily mistaken for a measurement of it.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: chameleon gazing into iridescent dome, sees own distorted reflection. Mood: seductive, uncanny.

samples.name: The Finished City
samples.power: Show the destination as already built. No scaffolding, no mud, no maintenance, no Tuesday.
samples.lore: The render is an argument dressed as a photograph of something that does not yet exist.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: poodle sitting pristine in perfect glass city plaza, no workers, no weather. Mood: uncannily clean, hollow.

items.title: IGNORE DYSTOPIA — Anatomy of a Trap (Deck B)

samples.name: The Doomsday Clock
samples.power: Set a public timer near midnight and move the hands by announcement, never by event.
samples.lore: A symbol of danger adjusted by judgment reads as objective measurement to the public.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink editorial. Subject: robed figure moving clock hands by decree. Mood: bureaucratic menace.

samples.name: The Perpetual Almost
samples.power: Keep the catastrophe permanently arriving and never arrived.
samples.lore: The fear tracks the coverage, not the actual events.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: propaganda illustration. Subject: disaster eternally approaching horizon but never landing. Mood: frozen dread.

samples.name: The Open Notebook
samples.power: Picture the future as a page with room left on it, not a poster on a wall.
samples.lore: Protopia is the idea that the future is a process of slow, incremental improvement you participate in.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor ink sketch, aged paper. Subject: eager beaver gripping oversized pencil, blank notebook open. Mood: focused readiness.

samples.name: The Erasable Line
samples.power: Draw the next step in pencil. Pencil means you expect to be wrong and stay anyway.
samples.lore: The ability to correct beats the appearance of certainty.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor ink sketch, aged paper. Subject: grinning raccoon erasing a blueprint mid-sketch. Mood: gleeful impermanence.

samples.name: THE VENETIAN LION
samples.power: Council of Ten: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Keep the secrets, bury the rest.
samples.lore: The original intelligence state. They invented the bond market and the secret police in the same afternoon.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: alchemical comic. Subject: winged lion with ledger and dagger. Mood: ancient cunning.

samples.name: THE VATICAN BANKER
samples.power: Lateran Treaty: Move any amount of Damage tokens from your Actor to an offshore discard pile.
samples.lore: Titles survive when nations fall. We wear black because we are mourning the loss of our visible power. The invisible kind pays better.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: gothic satire comic. Subject: cassocked goat with rosary and ledger. Mood: pious laundering.
